review: Convert the existing public ArchiveDialog into ArchivePanel without a duplicate dialog wrapper. Retain validated public loading, fixed GET update and exact pool/event identities; use shared ToolPage/navigation and existing full flow/raw-scene readers. Source hash skips identical reloads; disappearance of the installed cache retains original source-loss behavior instead of substituting the bundled source. Same pool/source preserves table identity, column/scroll and note selection. Visible-only tab height prevents hidden page minimums pushing controls below the viewport. Empty frequency columns hide without changing model values; effects use available width and wrapped row heights. Buttons explicitly disable auto-default to keep search Return local. Existing read-only game/private/chat boundaries remain.
